findings.paved_road: Have Scope in require the hold seed to take the then-existing storm predecessor tests and tests/test_daemon_composition.py as Context. Add to the hold's hooks (after owns) any predecessor test whose dispatch-hold-absence assertion the hold must migrate. Have tests/test_seeded_phase3_17.py pin that preservation/fence partition, as test_seeded_phase3_11.py does with PRESERVATION.
